author: codex
text: Mode 3 performs worse than direct mode on this simple case: the LLM correction path keeps a QueryRecord step but leaks incremental metadata into processor properties, creating four semantic validation errors plus the usual DBCP enabling issue.

author: Dmitry
text: Observed NiFi validation errors on the mode 3-style flow: QueryRecord leaked incremental and timestamp_column as invalid SQL properties, and the DBCP service stayed in Enabling state. This confirms the semantic correction path generated an invalid incremental extraction step.

author: codex
text: Compared with mode 0, mode 3 did not improve this PostgreSQL-only case. The correction path produced a structurally richer flow, but introduced invalid QueryRecord semantics and still left the DBCP service issue unresolved. For this case, semantic correction by full-document rewrite underperformed both on validity and on developer effort.
